verdict.rationale: Visa Intelligent Commerce is payment-rail infrastructure (tokenization, mandates, passkey authentication, Trusted Agent Protocol signatures) for authorizing agent-initiated purchases — it is not a product catalog or commerce-discovery service. Exposing machine-readable offer data (price, availability, variants) for arbitrary listed products is a merchant/catalog concern outside Visa's payments-focused API surface, so this axis is a category mismatch rather than an unmet capability.
